'''Maxina Sensis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Archaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] who worked at [[Daxis Outpost]] in the [[Jandolhoon system/Legends|Jandolhoon system]] as the [[Chief Researcher]].

==Biography==
Born in the [[Parkis system/Legends|Parkis system]], Sensis had a desire to make new discoveries before anyone else. She used this motivation to succeed in the top learning institutes in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Shortly before graduation, she saw a [[Hologram/Legends|promotional holo]] for the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services|Scout Service]]. This prompted her to forgo a lucrative career in the private sector and instead go to the Daxis Outpost to serve as the Chief Researcher.<ref name="AJ8" />

During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Sensis analyzed a series of [[Serianan statue|statues]] and [[Serianan runes|runes]] recovered from the [[Serianan system/Legends|Serianan system]] by the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Korren Starchaser]].<ref name="AJ8" />

==Personality and traits==
Sensis was attentive and eager. She had a passion for detail and was very optimistic.<ref name="AJ8" />
